widgets_values: 参考图像最多只能接入9张图像，如果不接入就关掉下面的开关
支持最多‌3 段视频‌（每段 2-15 秒，总时长不超过 15 秒），用于定义运镜风格或动作逻辑。
支持最多‌3 段音频‌（需与图像或视频搭配，总时长不超 15 秒），用于设置节奏、对白或环境声。

如果只要单采那就不要开启二阶段采样，分辨率选择器里选择你要的分辨率大小，推荐0.9，直出720p视频。
如果要开二阶段采样，那一阶段的分辨率就要调小，推荐0.4，先用低分辨率快速跑完一采，然后再用较低的步数再二次采样，此时二次采样就可以将分辨率拉高，根据自己的配置和需求来调（太高了也会影响速度）

PS：本地跑的话，可以先不开二采，先用一采来快速抽卡，抽到满意的，把种子锁定然后开二采来强化。

subject_definitions:
- <Subject 1>: A young Southeast Asian male presenter in his late 20s with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and dark shorts, as depicted in <Picture 1>.
- <Subject 2>: A modern sedan car parked outdoors on a hot day.
- <Picture 1>: Refers to the facial features, hairstyle, body build, and outfit of the male presenter.

summary:
- A 9:16 vertical video showing <Subject 1> inside <Subject 2> quickly pulling his hand back from a scalding hot steering wheel under intense sunlight, set to intense atmospheric sound and energetic background music.

retention_analysis:
- <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - facial structure, short black hair, white t-shirt, and skin tone from <Picture 1>.
- <Picture 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - visual identity and clothing of the presenter.

detailed_description:
- [Shot 1] Extreme close-up shot inside <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> reaches out and touches the burning hot black leather steering wheel, quickly recoiling his hand in pain with a grimace. <Subject 1> (S1) says with a concerned facial expression: <d>[Malay] Masih biarkan matahari panas merosakkan kereta anda?</d> On-screen text in bright yellow bold lettering reading "HENTIKAN KEROSAKAN KERETA! ☀️" flashes in the center.
- [Shot 2] Rapid camera zoom-out through the windshield showing <Subject 2> parked under scorching direct sunlight, with visible heat shimmer waves rising from the hood.

overall_soundscape:
- Sizzling heat effect, sudden gasp from <Subject 1>, and harsh ambient sun glare noise.

non_diegetic_music:
- Fast-paced, high-tension electronic synth beat creating a sense of urgency.

混合限制‌：
所有素材（图 + 视频 + 音频）混合输入时，总数不得超过‌12 个‌！！
